title: Wildly Snappy Malaysian Cheese Curd Noodles
description: A savory and snappy Malaysian dish featuring cheese curds and whole30-friendly ingredients, with an al-dente finish. This dish is perfect for a light and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: rice noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably made from rice flour and water

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions until they are al-dente.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the malaysian chili paste to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Add the cheese curds to the skillet and stir until they are well coated with the chili paste.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir until they are well combined with the cheese curds and chili paste.
Season the noodles with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the noodles hot and enjoy.
